title: प्रथमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 1 · The Pandavas leave for the forest

summary.en: The Pandavas leave Hastinapura by the north gate, followed by grieving citizens who curse the Kauravas and wish to go with them. Yudhishthira gently sends them back, and the brothers spend the first night under a great banyan by the Ganga, with Brahmins who insist on following them.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ಉತ್ತರದ್ವಾರದಿಂದ ಹಸ್ತಿನಾಪುರ ಬಿಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಕೌರವರನ್ನು ಶಪಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಬರಲು ಬಯಸುವ ದುಃಖಿತ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳು ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಮೃದುವಾಗಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಮರಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸಲು ಹಠಹಿಡಿದ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಹೋದರರು ಮೊದಲ ರಾತ್ರಿಯನ್ನು ಗಂಗಾತೀರದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಆಲದಮರದಡಿ ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डव उत्तर द्वार से हस्तिनापुर छोड़ते हैं, और कौरवों को कोसते तथा साथ चलने को आतुर दुःखी नगरवासी उनके पीछे चलते हैं। युधिष्ठिर उन्हें प्रेम से लौटा देते हैं, और साथ चलने का हठ करने वाले ब्राह्मणों के साथ भाई पहली रात गंगा-तट के एक विशाल बरगद के नीचे बिताते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులు ఉత్తరద్వారం గుండా హస్తినాపురాన్ని విడిచిపెడతారు; కౌరవులను తిడుతూ తమతో రావాలనుకునే దుఃఖిత పౌరులు వెంట వస్తారు. యుధిష్ఠిరుడు వారిని మృదువుగా వెనక్కి పంపుతాడు; వెంట రావాలని పట్టుబట్టిన బ్రాహ్మణులతో సోదరులు మొదటి రాత్రిని గంగాతీరంలోని పెద్ద మర్రిచెట్టు కింద గడుపుతారు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர்கள் வடக்கு வாயில் வழியாக ஹஸ்தினாபுரத்தை விட்டுச் செல்ல, கௌரவர்களைச் சபித்தபடி உடன் வர விரும்பும் துயருற்ற குடிமக்கள் பின்தொடர்கிறார்கள். யுதிஷ்டிரர் அவர்களை அன்புடன் திருப்பி அனுப்ப, பின்தொடர வலியுறுத்திய அந்தணர்களுடன் சகோதரர்கள் முதல் இரவைக் கங்கைக்கரையிலுள்ள பெரிய ஆலமரத்தடியில் கழிக்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ ഹസ്തിനാപുരത്തിന്റെ വടക്കേ വാതിലിലൂടെ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു. കൗരവരെ ശപിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് കൂടെ വരാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന ദുഃഖിതരായ പൗരന്മാർ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു. യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ അവരെ സൗമ്യമായി മടക്കി അയക്കുന്നു; സഹോദരന്മാർ ഗംഗാതീരത്തെ വലിയ ആലിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ആദ്യരാത്രി കഴിക്കുന്നു, കൂടെ വരാൻ വാശിപിടിച്ച ബ്രാഹ്മണരോടൊപ്പം.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.1; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
एवं द्यूतजिताः पार्थाः कोपिताश्च दुरात्मभिः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रैः सहामात्यैर्निकृत्या द्विजसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, the sons of Pritha had been beaten at dice and goaded by the wicked sons of Dhritarashtra and their ministers, who had cheated them.

verses.text:
श्राविताः परुषा वाचः सृजद्भिर्वैरमुत्तमम् ।
किमकुर्वन्त कौरव्या मम पूर्वपितामहाः ॥

meaning.en: They had been made to hear harsh words, and enmity of the worst kind had been sown. What did those Kauravas, my forefathers, do then?

verses.text:
कथं चैश्वर्यविभ्रष्टाः सहसा दुःखमेयुषः ।
वने विजह्रिरे पार्थाः शक्रप्रतिमतेजसः ॥

meaning.en: Suddenly fallen from their sovereignty and plunged in grief, how did the sons of Pritha, equal to Indra in splendor, live in the forest?

verses.text:
के चैनानन्ववर्तन्त प्राप्तान्व्यसनमुत्तमम् ।
किमाहाराः किमाचाराः क्व च वासो महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Who followed those great men in their deep misfortune? What did they eat, how did they conduct themselves, and where did they dwell?

verses.text:
कथं द्वादश वर्षाणि वने तेषां महात्मनाम् ।
व्यतीयुर्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ शूराणामरिघातिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Best of Brahmins, how did those heroic slayers of enemies pass twelve years in the forest?

verses.text:
कथं च राजपुत्री सा प्रवरा सर्वयोषिताम् ।
पतिव्रता महाभागा सततं सत्यवादिनी ।
वनवासमदुःखार्हा दारुणं प्रत्यपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: And how did the princess, foremost of women, devoted to her husbands, blessed and ever truthful, who did not deserve hardship, endure the cruel forest life?

verses.text:
एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं विस्तरेण तपोधन ।
श्रोतुमिच्छामि चरितं भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम् ।
कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥

meaning.en: Tell me all this in detail, ascetic. I wish to hear the deeds of those men of great wealth and splendor; my curiosity about them is very great.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं द्यूतजिताः पार्थाः कोपिताश्च दुरात्मभिः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रैः सहामात्यैर्निर्ययुर्गजसाह्वयात् ॥

meaning.en: So the sons of Pritha, beaten at dice and provoked by the wicked sons of Dhritarashtra with their counselors, set out from Hastinapura.

verses.text:
वर्धमानपुरद्वारेणाभिनिष्क्रम्य ते तदा ।
उदङ्मुखाः शस्त्रभृतः प्रययुः सह कृष्णया ॥

meaning.en: They left through the Vardhamana gate and went north, bearing weapons, together with Krishna Draupadi.

verses.text:
इन्द्रसेनादयश्चैनान्भृत्याः परिचतुर्दश ।
रथैरनुययुः शीघ्रैः स्त्रिय आदाय सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Indrasena and the others, fourteen servants in all, followed them on swift chariots, taking the women of the household.

verses.text:
व्रजतस्तान्विदित्वा तु पौराः शोकाभिपीडिताः ।
गर्हयन्तोऽसकृद्भीष्मविदुरद्रोणगौतमान् ।
ऊचुर्विगतसंत्रासाः समागम्य परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Learning that the Pandavas were leaving, the townspeople, crushed with sorrow, repeatedly reproached Bhishma, Vidura, Drona and Kripa. Fearless, they gathered and said to one another:

verses.text:
नेदमस्ति कुलं सर्वं न वयं न च नो गृहाः ।
यत्र दुर्योधनः पापः सौबलेयेन पालितः ।
कर्णदुःशासनाभ्यां च राज्यमेतच्चिकीर्षति ॥

meaning.en: This is no longer our whole family, nor are we ourselves or our homes, when wicked Duryodhana, backed by Shakuni's son, Karna and Duhshasana, means to rule this kingdom.

verses.text:
नो चेत्कुलं न चाचारो न धर्मोऽर्थः कुतः सुखम् ।
यत्र पापसहायोऽयं पापो राज्यं बुभूषते ॥

meaning.en: Where there is no family honor, no good conduct, no dharma and no prosperity, how can there be happiness? Here a sinner with sinful allies wants the kingdom.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनो गुरुद्वेषी त्यक्ताचारसुहृज्जनः ।
अर्थलुब्धोऽभिमानी च नीचः प्रकृतिनिर्घृणः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana hates his elders, has abandoned proper conduct and his friends, is greedy for wealth, proud, base and cruel by nature.

verses.text:
नेयमस्ति मही कृत्स्ना यत्र दुर्योधनो नृपः ।
साधु गच्छामहे सर्वे यत्र गच्छन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: The whole earth is not worth living on where Duryodhana is king. Let us go gladly where the Pandavas go.

verses.text:
सानुक्रोशा महात्मानो विजितेन्द्रियशत्रवः ।
ह्रीमन्तः कीर्तिमन्तश्च धर्माचारपरायणाः ॥

meaning.en: They are compassionate, great-souled, masters of their senses and conquerors of foes, modest, renowned and devoted to righteous conduct.

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वानुजग्मुस्तान्पाण्डवांस्ते समेत्य च ।
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे तान्कुन्तीमाद्रिनन्दनान् ॥

meaning.en: Saying this, they followed the Pandavas, and joining them, they folded their hands and spoke to Kunti's sons and Madri's sons.

verses.text:
क्व गमिष्यथ भद्रं वस्त्यक्त्वास्मान्दुःखभागिनः ।
वयमप्यनुयास्यामो यत्र यूयं गमिष्यथ ॥

meaning.en: Blessings on you, but where will you go, leaving us to our grief? We will follow wherever you go.

verses.text:
अधर्मेण जिताञ्श्रुत्वा युष्मांस्त्यक्तघृणैः परैः ।
उद्विग्नाः स्म भृशं सर्वे नास्मान्हातुमिहार्हथ ॥

meaning.en: We were shaken to hear that you were beaten unjustly by enemies who threw away all pity; do not abandon us.

verses.text:
भक्तानुरक्ताः सुहृदः सदा प्रियहिते रतान् ।
कुराजाधिष्ठिते राज्ये न विनश्येम सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: We are your loyal, loving friends, always devoted to your good. Let us not be utterly ruined in a kingdom ruled by a bad king.

verses.text:
श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामो गुणदोषान्नरर्षभाः ।
शुभाशुभाधिवासेन संसर्गं कुरुते यथा ॥

meaning.en: Hear, bulls among men, the good and the harm we speak of, and how association works through the company one keeps, whether good or bad.

verses.text:
वस्त्रमापस्तिलान्भूमिं गन्धो वासयते यथा ।
पुष्पाणामधिवासेन तथा संसर्गजा गुणाः ॥

meaning.en: As cloth, water, sesame seeds and earth take on the scent of whatever perfumes them, so the qualities of flowers pass into what lies near them; so too do qualities come from association.

verses.text:
मोहजालस्य योनिर्हि मूढैरेव समागमः ।
अहन्यहनि धर्मस्य योनिः साधुसमागमः ॥

meaning.en: The source of the net of delusion is mixing with fools; the daily source of dharma is the company of the good.

verses.text:
तस्मात्प्राज्ञैश्च वृद्धैश्च सुस्वभावैस्तपस्विभिः ।
सद्भिश्च सह संसर्गः कार्यः शमपरायणैः ॥

meaning.en: So one should keep company with the wise, the elders, the well-natured, the ascetics and the good who love peace.

verses.text:
येषां त्रीण्यवदातानि योनिर्विद्या च कर्म च ।
तान्सेवेत्तैः समास्या हि शास्त्रेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ॥

meaning.en: Serve those who are pure in three things: birth, learning and conduct. Associating with them is worth more than the scriptures.

verses.text:
निरारम्भा ह्यपि वयं पुण्यशीलेषु साधुषु ।
पुण्यमेवाप्नुयामेह पापं पापोपसेवनात् ॥

meaning.en: Even if we do nothing ourselves, among virtuous and good people we gain merit, and from keeping company with sinners we gain sin.

verses.text:
असतां दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्संजल्पनसहासनात् ।
धर्माचाराः प्रहीयन्ते न च सिध्यन्ति मानवाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing, touching, talking with and sitting beside the wicked make righteous conduct decline, and men do not succeed.

verses.text:
बुद्धिश्च हीयते पुंसां नीचैः सह समागमात् ।
मध्यमैर्मध्यतां याति श्रेष्ठतां याति चोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: A man's intelligence declines through mixing with the low, stays middling with the middling, and rises to excellence with the best.

verses.text:
ये गुणाः कीर्तिता लोके धर्मकामार्थसंभवाः ।
लोकाचारात्मसंभूता वेदोक्ताः शिष्टसंमताः ॥

meaning.en: All the virtues praised in the world, born of dharma, desire and wealth, grounded in custom and the Vedas and approved by the cultured, are found in you, together and singly.

verses.text:
ते युष्मासु समस्ताश्च व्यस्ताश्चैवेह सद्गुणाः ।
इच्छामो गुणवन्मध्ये वस्तुं श्रेयोऽभिकाङ्क्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: We who seek our welfare wish to live among people of virtue.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
धन्या वयं यदस्माकं स्नेहकारुण्ययन्त्रिताः ।
असतोऽपि गुणानाहुर्ब्राह्मणप्रमुखाः प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: We are blessed that the people, led by the Brahmins, bound by affection and pity, credit even us, who lack virtue, with good qualities.

verses.text:
तदहं भ्रातृसहितः सर्वान्विज्ञापयामि वः ।
नान्यथा तद्धि कर्तव्यमस्मत्स्नेहानुकम्पया ॥

meaning.en: So I, with my brothers, ask all of you: you must not act otherwise, out of love and compassion for us.

verses.text:
भीष्मः पितामहो राजा विदुरो जननी च मे ।
सुहृज्जनश्च प्रायो मे नगरे नागसाह्वये ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather Bhishma, King Dhritarashtra, Vidura, my mother, and most of my friends are in the city of Hastinapura.

verses.text:
ते त्वस्मद्धितकामार्थं पालनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ।
युष्माभिः सहितैः सर्वैः शोकसंतापविह्वलाः ॥

meaning.en: They are distraught with sorrow and grief; for our good, all of you together must take careful care of them.

verses.text:
निवर्ततागता दूरं समागमनशापिताः ।
स्वजने न्यासभूते मे कार्या स्नेहान्विता मतिः ॥

meaning.en: You have come far; turn back, I ask you by my entreaty. Let your minds be kind to my kinsfolk, who are left in your keeping.

verses.text:
एतद्धि मम कार्याणां परमं हृदि संस्थितम् ।
सुकृतानेन मे तुष्टिः सत्कारश्च भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: This is the weightiest of my concerns, fixed in my heart. By doing this you will gratify and honor me.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तथानुमन्त्रितास्तेन धर्मराजेन ताः प्रजाः ।
चक्रुरार्तस्वरं घोरं हा राजन्निति दुःखिताः ॥

meaning.en: Thus urged by King Dharma's son Yudhishthira, the people cried out in a terrible, anguished voice, "Alas, king!"

verses.text:
गुणान्पार्थस्य संस्मृत्य दुःखार्ताः परमातुराः ।
अकामाः संन्यवर्तन्त समागम्याथ पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Remembering the virtues of Pritha's son, tormented and overcome with grief, they turned back unwillingly after meeting the Pandavas.

verses.text:
निवृत्तेषु तु पौरेषु रथानास्थाय पाण्डवाः ।
प्रजग्मुर्जाह्नवीतीरे प्रमाणाख्यं महावटम् ॥

meaning.en: When the townspeople had gone back, the Pandavas mounted their chariots and reached the great banyan called Pramana on the bank of the Ganga.

verses.text:
तं ते दिवसशेषेण वटं गत्वा तु पाण्डवाः ।
ऊषुस्तां रजनीं वीराः संस्पृश्य सलिलं शुचि ।
उदकेनैव तां रात्रिमूषुस्ते दुःखकर्शिताः ॥

meaning.en: They reached that banyan at the end of the day, and those heroes spent the night there after purifying themselves with water, wasted by grief, taking only water that night.

verses.text:
अनुजग्मुश्च तत्रैतान्स्नेहात्केचिद्द्विजातयः ।
साग्नयोऽनग्नयश्चैव सशिष्यगणबान्धवाः ।
स तैः परिवृतो राजा शुशुभे ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Some Brahmins out of affection followed them there, some with sacred fires and some without, with pupils and kinsmen. Surrounded by those expounders of Brahman, the king shone.

verses.text:
तेषां प्रादुष्कृताग्नीनां मुहूर्ते रम्यदारुणे ।
ब्रह्मघोषपुरस्कारः संजल्पः समजायत ॥

meaning.en: At that pleasant yet fearsome hour, as they kindled their fires, a conversation arose amid the chanting of the Vedas.

verses.text:
राजानं तु कुरुश्रेष्ठं ते हंसमधुरस्वराः ।
आश्वासयन्तो विप्राग्र्याः क्षपां सर्वां व्यनोदयन् ॥

meaning.en: Those eminent Brahmins, with voices sweet as swans, comforted the best of the Kurus, King Yudhishthira, and passed the whole night with him.
